card.name: Word after a country or nationality
card.fires_on: The word right after a country's name or nationality used as a modifier, such as Mexico's, UK's, Spanish, Japanese or Zimbabwe's. It sits where an institution, title or noun is expected next.

modes.label: Possessive country before institution
modes.description: A country's possessive form is followed by a company, agency or office title.
modes.example: state-owned national oil companies like Saudi Aramco, Mexico’s<< P>>emex, and Venezuela’s Pd

modes.label: Nationality before title or noun
modes.description: A nationality adjective is followed by a noun such as civil war, prime minister or comic.

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens are mostly unrelated odd fragments, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It fires on the word that follows a country name or nationality, such as the start of an agency name or a title.
